description:
Identify all papers in the library that are 5 pages or fewer in length and add the tag 'short-read' to them.

To do this:
1. Browse through the items in your library.
2. Look at the 'Pages' field in the Info pane for each paper (e.g., '269-271' means 3 pages).
3. Calculate the page count (inclusive).
4. If the paper is 5 pages or less, add the tag 'short-read' (without quotes).

Do not tag papers longer than 5 pages.

ground_truth_titles: A Note on Two Problems in Connexion with Graphs
Molecular Structure of Nucleic Acids: A Structure for Deoxyribose Nucleic Acid
A Method for the Construction of Minimum-Redundancy Codes
distractor_titles: Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks and Tree Search
